Project too large for full screen

The generated project exceeds the browser session storage limit (~5MB). Use the Download ZIP button in the preview panel to get all files.
notes: no heading element at all — the title is plain text, so a getByRole('heading') assertion fails; match on text
no actionable control: it names the Download ZIP button but does not link to it, and there is no way back
dead end — the user must use browser Back
